# Sean Taylor

> Games product strategist and executive producer, based in Dubai, working remotely. Thirty years shipping games on whatever platform was new: console at DMA Design (Grand Theft Auto, GTA 2), mobile before smartphones, interactive television before app stores, then browser and social. Founded InGAME, the UK's £5.3m national games innovation centre. Co-author of Punk Playthings (CRC Press, 2017).

Sean works with founders, studios, publishers and IP owners on platform and format decisions: whether a new surface is worth building for, what to build when it is, and how to get it made. He is a hands-on product architect as well as a strategist — close enough to the work to prototype an idea rather than only describe it.

## What he is asked about

- Platform strategy for games: evaluating new and emerging platforms, their audiences, capabilities, discovery systems and monetisation models
- Connected TV and cloud gaming, including interactive television, ten-foot UI and phone-as-controller play
- Instant games, browser games and web ports: whether to port, what it costs, what it cannibalises
- Playable advertising and branded playable formats
- Licensed IP and brand games: matching intellectual property to mechanics under commercial and licensor constraint
- Casual and free-to-play product: onboarding, progression, retention, live operations
- Product management for emerging formats and new content types
- Game production systems: release cadence, talent pipelines, delivery against fixed budgets and immovable deadlines
- Direct-to-consumer monetisation and community engagement design
- Games research, innovation programmes and public investment in the sector

## Career

- 2026–present: Product lead on an unannounced AA game; fractional product strategy and audience-engagement advisory
- 2024–2026: Chief Product Officer, Battlepass Labs — productising brand engagement inside live games
- 2018–2024: Executive Director, InGAME / Abertay University — £5.3m UK government-funded games R&D centre; 177 industry collaborations, 2,283 professionals upskilled, £84.7m projected gross value added, 16x return on public investment
- 2015–2018: Managing Director, The Producers — production and strategic advisory consultancy; Crackdown 3, Strawberry Thief, UAL Games Fusion
- 2006–2015: Producer / Product Architect, Denki — 100+ titles in nine years across interactive TV (Sky, DirecTV), mobile, browser and console; Quarrel, Denki Blocks!, and licensed games for the BBC, DreamWorks, Fox, LEGO, Mattel, Mind Candy, Nickelodeon and Pixar
- 2005–2006: Director of Mobile Development, DC Studios — Family Guy, Star Wars, NASCAR
- 2001–2005: Digital Producer, MediaCo — interactive brand campaigns for 3M, Reebok, Nestlé
- 1996–2000: DMA Design — QA on Grand Theft Auto, mission design on GTA 2, QA lead on Body Harvest, level design on Tanktics

## Recognition

- BAFTA full voting member
- Quarrel: BAFTA Scotland Best Game (2011), BAFTA Games Mobile & Handheld nominee (2012), three TIGA Awards (2012)
- InGAME: Excellence in Games Research, Abertay University (2021)
- Games Fusion Project, UAL: Best Education Initiative (2019)
